facts.fact: The Banque de la Republique du Burundi said it set up BurundiPay, a national instant payment system running 24 hours a day alongside the existing RTGS, ACH and CSD systems, and told traders about it at a workshop on 24 November 2026.

systems.owner: Banque de la Republique du Burundi

BDI.note: A regulatory framework for payment systems is mentioned without content on consumer or conduct rules for digital finance.
Document says nothing on cross-border payments.
Document says nothing on government payments to people.
No survey share of adults with accounts stated.

facts.fact: The Banque de la Republique du Burundi said BurundiPay is in use by the population for transfers by QR code, USSD and OTP from a phone, in about 10 seconds, for holders of a bank or microfinance account.

systems.owner: Banque de la Republique du Burundi

BDI.note: No link between wallets and banks or one national switch stated.
Document says nothing on electronic payment of taxes or fees.
